span.label: The hippocampal local field potential in freely moving rats, and whether the animal's position can be read out of it.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: If no single electrode's field potential is tuned to place, can position nevertheless be recovered from many electrodes at once?
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Shows the spatiotemporal structure of the theta rhythm encodes position about as well as spiking populations do, and introduces feature-tuned field potentials as the LFP counterpart of place cells.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because hippocampal place cells are not topographically arranged, any one electrode pools dissimilarly tuned neurons and therefore shows only weak place modulation, which is why the code appears only across many sites
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: During movement the population is driven by a single sparse cause - current position - so unsupervised source separation can recover that cause from mixed, subsampled field-potential measurements
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The theta LFP inherits position information because it is generated mainly by the membrane potential fluctuations of the place cell population itself
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the theta rhythm is treated as a radio carrier wave, and position is recovered by demodulating it - stripping the carrier phase to leave a spatial pattern
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the LFP carries place information because it is generated by the membrane potentials of the place-cell population itself
span.note: duplicate of: mechanisms[2]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: position is a single sparse cause driving the whole population, which is why an unsupervised method can recover it without being told where the rat is
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The unsupervised (ICA) discovery of position-tuned field-potential features degrades as trial-by-trial neuronal variability grows: fewer components are recovered from noisy populations.
span.note: what this limits: the number of position-tuned components recovered: AS THE TRIAL-BY-TRIAL VARIABILITY OF NEURONAL ACTIVITY WAS INCREASED, ICA IDENTIFIED A DECREASING NUMBER OF FFPs
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Each electrode pools a large, non-topographically-ordered population, so any single site is only weakly place-modulated.
span.note: what this limits: any single-site interpretation of the field potential: EACH ELECTRODE SUBSAMPLES (POOLS) THE ACTIVITY OF A LARGE POPULATION OF NEURONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The method degrades with neuronal variability: noisier populations yield fewer recoverable components.
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[0] · what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - the component count is partly a measure of the noise
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Recovered component width is bounded by the tuning width of the underlying population, so the readout cannot be sharper than what generates it.
span.note: what this limits: the spatial resolution of the readout: FOR NOISY POPULATIONS, FFP WIDTH INCREASED IN PROPORTION TO, BUT NEVER EXCEEDED, THE TUNING WIDTH OF THE UNDERLYING POPULATION'S PLACE FIELDS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The mechanistic account of how FFPs relate to neuronal populations rests on a simulation, not on measurement.
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic account linking components to populations: A SIMULATION WAS CONSTRUCTED IN WHICH THE LFP WAS MODELED AS THE SUPERIMPOSED ACTIVITY GENERATED BY NUMEROUS PLACE-MODULATED SYNAPTIC INPUTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The carrier-wave and demodulation model: theta is treated as a carrier whose modulation carries the message, and the analysis strips the carrier phase to read that message out
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The spatiotemporal structure of the hippocampal theta rhythm, sampled across many electrodes, encodes the rat's position about as well as populations of spiking neurons do.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Decoding accuracy from field potentials matched that from spikes, with a slightly smaller median error, though the two decoders depended differently on running velocity and position.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Successful decoding required both removing the theta carrier phase and keeping the signal's high dimensionality, even though most of its variance lay in a low-dimensional subspace.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Unsupervised decomposition of the theta-band field potential recovered components that fire selectively at particular track positions and carry most of the signal variance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Each FFP's phase advanced progressively as the animal crossed its field, mirroring theta phase precession of place cell spikes.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: FFPs covered the track more evenly than pyramidal cell place fields did, which matched the relative accuracy of the two decoders.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Position could still be decoded and FFPs still identified from dendritic-layer sites where no spikes were recorded, so the code is not an artefact of spike contamination.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A different, broadband sparse-coding analysis recovered position-tuned components spread along the whole track, matching the theta-band result.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In simulation, raising trial-to-trial neuronal variability reduced the number of recoverable FFPs and widened them, but never beyond the tuning width of the underlying population.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Position decoded from the LFP is about as accurate as position decoded from spikes - median error 6.7 cm against 9.2 cm.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Unsupervised decomposition finds components that fire at specific track positions, without ever being told the rat's position.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: These components carry most of the signal - 53 to 79% of total variance across three rats.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The recovered components behave like place cells in several respects, including phase precession, while differing in others.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
